blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Executive Secretary Ralph Recto urged businesses to turn regional partnerships and trade agreements into growth opportunities, speaking at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Business and Investment Summit. Recto urged businesses to deliver on three key priorities aligned with Asean’s regional cooperation agreements: use regional agreements as opportunities for business development, invest in the foundations of regional resilience, and make innovations work for businesses of every size. With the signing of the Digital Economy Framework Agreement and the Asean-Canada Free Trade Agreement in the coming days, Recto urged businesses to prepare and help smaller enterprises benefit from the […]...
